title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Colour-field cookbook photography. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Colour-field cookbook
options.lineage: Modern cookbook photography on flat saturated backdrops
options.thesis: Every dish sits on its own colour field, like a cookbook spread.
options.viewport: Your ingredients on white, recipe cards below as photo-on-colour blocks.
options.risk: Gets loud if every surface takes a colour; white must stay the ground.

raised.raise: A strict type grid so the colour blocks read as order, not noise.
Ingredients you have are set heavier than ones you still need.

options.label: Nutrition facts panel
options.thesis: Have and still-need read like a food label: ruled, bold, honest.
options.viewport: A ruled panel listing your ingredients, recipes as label rows below.
options.risk: Familiar label trope; can feel clinical next to warm food photos.

options.label: Catalog sleeve
options.thesis: Recipes as a numbered catalogue on a strict grid.
options.viewport: Numbered recipe index with a colour bar per entry.
options.case: Fuses well and orders results clearly; loses on warmth next to food.
options.risk: Can feel cold and designer-ish for a home kitchen.

options.label: Warm consumer app
options.lineage: Polished consumer apps with soft warm surfaces
options.thesis: Soft rounded cards, warm neutrals, friendly and calm.
options.viewport: Rounded ingredient field, horizontally scrolling recipe cards.
options.case: Safe and clear, but close to the generic template look you want to avoid.
options.risk: Reads generic; easy to mistake for any other recipe app.

options.label: Type specimen
options.thesis: Type weight and width carry the meaning.
options.viewport: Ingredient names set huge, weight showing what you have.
options.case: Fuses poorly: photos lose the lead to the type.
options.kept: Weight as data: what you have is set heavier.

options.label: Character goods shelf
options.thesis: Every dish a collectible on a bright shelf.
options.case: Declined: reads childish, which you asked to avoid.
options.kept: Small badges as quick status reads.

options.label: Midnight transit map
options.thesis: Steps as stations on a line.
options.viewport: A dark map of ingredients leading to dishes.
options.case: Declined: dark and heavy, which you asked to avoid.
options.kept: Numbered steps as a clear line in the recipe.

options.label: Botanical folio
options.thesis: Ingredients as plates in a seasonal folio.
options.case: Declined: slow and decorative for a fast kitchen task.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What recipe apps ship, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Search field, chips, photo cards in a list.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
